newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman reiterates AMR as outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman reiterates AMR as outperform.

text.p: - Lehman Brothers analyst Brian Harris reiterated his outperform rating for AMR Corp, the parent of American Airlines.

- AMR's prospectus for its proposed spin-off of its SABRE division values the reservation and information systems unit at between $2.56 and $2.94 billion, including a 10 percent to 15 percent IPO discount, Harris said.
- This valuation falls within Lehman Brothers's estimated $2.76 to $3.68 billion valuation range, Harris said.

- "Although the preliminary valuation of SABRE appears within our conservative estimate range, other investors who held more aggressive valuations for the technology unit may be disappointed," Harris said.
- On the airline side of AMR, American Airlines has a "disadvantageous" cost structure compared with other airlines following its recent labor agreement with its pilots, Harris said.
